editorial_thesis: This week's agent-trust failures got their audit layer today: a forensic trace through the resold-inference market, an in-process sandbox for agent code, a services playbook that asks whether the AI is actually doing the work, and creative/memory tools that ship rather than promise.

topic_groups.title: Inference Supply Chain Audit
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Yesterday's store-shelf lane covered package supply chain; today's HN front page delivered the inference-side counterpart — a forensic trace tying Novita/StreamLake/Ant Digital to ByteDance Ark, days after MiniMax admitted its security system read URLs in forwarded (including ZDR) requests. Material escalation of an open story, not a repeat.

sources.title: Novita, StreamLake, etc are Ark wrappers
sources.why_selected: Fingerprint-based trace (error strings, tool-call ids, request-id passthrough) showing ~1.1T+ tokens/week routed to ByteDance Ark through providers marketed as US ZDR.
sources.usefulness: Basis for a provider/processor audit across every API key; client data-residency pitch material.

sources.title: MiniMax: update on URL access in forwarded API requests
sources.why_selected: Admitted third-party opening of URLs embedded in prompts forwarded by AtlasCloud/Novita/StreamLake, including ZDR-flagged ones; 16 Novita endpoints pulled from OpenRouter.
sources.usefulness: Concrete proof that every inference hop is a data processor.

sources.title: Moat membership — wholesale model pricing
sources.why_selected: HN 281 pts; $5/mo membership with claimed 40-70% discounts via pooled buying power and zero router fee.
sources.usefulness: Real cost lever for GLM/DeepSeek-heavy agent workloads — after verifying its routing chain.

sources.title: Google Workspace AI Tools Addendum: agents must use Google MCP from Feb 2027
sources.why_selected: From Feb 1 2027 AI-agent tools must route Workspace through Google's MCP servers; Gmail send stays partner-gated; 30-day cap on embeddings/memory indexes built from Workspace data.
sources.usefulness: Nine-week compliance clock for any Gmail/Calendar agent; kills the index-once memory pattern.

topic_groups.title: AI-Native Services Playbook
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fills the founders/operators gap: no dedicated lane since Oct's small-team AI offers. Emergence's AINS playbook (Mirage PMF, AI-share metrics, COGS discipline) maps directly onto Buildn's productized-service model, and two HN front-page essays reinforce the operator angle.

sources.title: The AI-Native Services Playbook (Emergence Capital)
sources.why_selected: First systematic operator guide for AI-powered services: Mirage PMF, domain credibility, leading vs lagging metrics, HITL labor in COGS.
sources.usefulness: Define and instrument an AI-share metric per engagement; quarterly self-audit frame.

sources.title: One Metric That Matters (Hustle Fund)
sources.why_selected: Fresh, practical OMTM discipline for small teams tracking ten numbers and moving none.
sources.usefulness: Pick Buildn's December focus metric.

sources.title: Company Culture = Slack Emoji ÷ √Headcount
sources.why_selected: HN 318 pts; free, unfakeable culture proxy from workspace exports.
sources.usefulness: Cheap-proxy instinct for Buildn OS analytics; client icebreaker.

sources.title: AI made self-hosting fun again
sources.why_selected: HN 640 pts; agents treating Git-managed infra as a software project halved-to-tenths the cost of trying new technology — friction, not interest, was the constraint.
sources.usefulness: Core pitch framing for Buildn: make trying cheap.

topic_groups.title: Verification Culture
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Steps back from Nov 23/26 formal-math headlines to the underlying question — who verifies agent-written software — with a front-page manifesto, a craft counterpoint, and a hardware-economics datapoint affecting local-first storage plans.

sources.title: The need for a mainstream verifiable programming language
sources.why_selected: HN 135 pts; names the human contract (statements must capture intent) that no checker automates — the theoretical spine of checker-gated delivery.
sources.usefulness: Rationale for Buildn OS review gates; PR-review discipline.

sources.title: Do You Write Code With Your Mouse? (Vim manual, 4 years)
sources.why_selected: HN 159 pts; 170-exercise deliberate-practice structure — a template for skill scaffolds including agent skills.
sources.usefulness: Editor practice; skill-scaffold design pattern.

sources.title: Hard Drive pricing has gotten bad
sources.why_selected: Eight years of receipts: $12.50/TB (2024) to $27.50/TB (2026) on the same SKU; storage deflation is over.
sources.usefulness: Re-price Env Vault retention assumptions; consolidate disks.

topic_groups.title: Sandboxed Execution Comes to Node
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Converges the week's security arc (side channels, malicious packages, runtime shields) on the missing primitive: running untrusted agent code safely in-process. NormalScript is a Show HN with an unusually honest test262 matrix.

sources.title: NormalScript: a perfectly normal scripting language
sources.why_selected: HN 104 pts; strict JS-subset VM embedding in Node>=24/Bun with no WASM, capability-passed host functions, pause-to-bytes resumability, 19,408 test262 passing.
sources.usefulness: Candidate runner for agent-authored workflow steps; Env Vault local-trusted layer.

sources.title: Side by Side: three Linux VMs in a browser tab
sources.why_selected: HN 137 pts; zero-install cross-engine visual QA — where agent-generated front-ends fail silently.
sources.usefulness: QA spot checks on client staging URLs.

sources.title: rvoip: Rust SIP/VoIP stack with AI voice agents
sources.why_selected: v0.5.1, 3,165 commits, HN 124 pts; self-hosted escape hatch from hosted voice economics.
sources.usefulness: Track to 1.0 as the self-hosted leg of the voice-agent stack.

topic_groups.title: Memory Systems for Humans
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Learning/memory last ran Nov 23 with research (sleep framework); today ships a product: Olumino brings FSRS-7 scheduling with Anki round-tripping to HN, plus two reading items on uncertainty and curiosity that inform gate design and learning culture.

sources.title: Olumino: Flashcards & Notes
sources.why_selected: HN 104 pts; FSRS-7 scheduling, Anki import with review history, full one-file export, moon-phase progress visual, free classes mode.
sources.usefulness: Arabic study daily driver; memory-scheduling analogy for agent memory design.

sources.title: An introduction to uncertainty in machine learning
sources.why_selected: HN 75 pts; aleatoric vs epistemic uncertainty maps cleanly to when a workflow needs a human gate vs better data.
sources.usefulness: Vocabulary for agent-confidence conversations; gate-design rationale.

sources.title: Curiosity Is No Solo Act (MIT Press)
sources.why_selected: HN 150 pts; curiosity as sustained social practice — supports shared-Q&A logs over private reading lists.
sources.usefulness: Framing for Buildn's learning loops and workflow Q&A logs.

topic_groups.title: Creative Tools Go Local
topic_groups.selection_rationale: First creative-tools lane since Nov 22; the signal moved from design platforms to local-first media production. AutoClip is the day's fastest-growing repo (889 stars/day) and its MCP server makes media pipelines agent-callable.

sources.title: AutoClip: open-source OpusClip alternative
sources.why_selected: 17.3k stars, 889/day; local-first clipping pipeline (transcribe → cut → subtitles → covers → captions) with an MCP server for agent-driven operation.
sources.usefulness: Zero-subscription video→shorts pipeline; productizable offer for client content.

sources.title: YouTube Ad Punisher
sources.why_selected: HN 383 pts; reloads pages on ads — incentive-level protest with a rich creator-economics thread.
sources.usefulness: Intel for content/creator-revenue clients; not for shipping.

sources.title: BlenderUI Charts
sources.why_selected: HN 101 pts; full chart component system (7 base, 73 derived) rendered inside Blender 3D scenes.
sources.usefulness: Dashboards inside architecture walkthroughs; novel client demo.
